facts.fact: Minister Mariam Hamadou Ali says the LinkWise integrated project, financed in full (US$1.35bn) by Shanghai LinkWise and Shanghai Nenghui Technology on 1,000 hectares granted by the government, will build a 100 MW intelligent computing centre (AIDC) using NVIDIA H and B series chips, with first-phase construction and commissioning expected within three years of an MOU valid for one year.
facts.system: AIDC (intelligent computing centre) of the LinkWise Group project

systems.system: AIDC (intelligent computing centre), LinkWise Group project
systems.platform: NVIDIA H and B series GPUs (planned)
systems.owner: Shanghai LinkWise and Shanghai Nenghui Technology
